decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is tightly aligned with the firm's long-established automation, formwork and control capabilities, and after remaining in the portfolio it is more likely to be improved than withdrawn.
The profile storage robot still builds on the firm's existing plant and material-flow knowledge, but as a more specialized module it retains some risk if demand stays limited across projects.

The combined magazining cleaning and plotting machine fits the firm's integrated precast-production know-how and, as a product line with several models, offers scope to adapt variants rather than exit the market quickly.

The production analysis software is close to the firm's controls and service base and benefits from in-house R&D and installed-base learning, though software adoption and ongoing development needs make it somewhat more uncertain than core machinery.
